+

fix and complete the task 1 website

/home/avishkar/Documents/germany/uni-paderborn/sem-3/courses/agentic_soft_engg/agentic-software-engineering-team-18/lab_1/group-18/task1_opencode/site

TASK: Rebuild task1_opencode/site/index.html from scratch as ONE standalone file (HTML + CSS + JS only, nothing loaded from the internet: no CDN, no web fonts, no remote images). You may reuse ideas from the existing file but do not keep its clutter.

FIRST (before coding)
- Read README.md, all content/*.md (annie, avishkar, parastoo, parsa, sophika), and look at content/images/. Read embed_images.py and check_site.py to see how to use them.
- Create a short AGENTS.md with these rules: single file, no external loads, exactly 5 members from content/, run check_site.py before finishing.
- Facts about members come ONLY from their .md files. Never invent facts. Member-specific jokes may only reuse what that person wrote, and must be kind. Tone: university-appropriate: no profanity, politics, insults, or jokes about the instructors, the university, or any person's appearance, background or abilities.

DESIGN GOAL: calm, uncluttered, fun. Lots of whitespace, two accent colors max, one typeface stack (system fonts). Exactly ONE joke per block; plain, clear text first. Do not add taglines AND intros to the same section.

STRUCTURE (one page, sticky minimal nav, smooth scroll)
1. Hero: team name, one funny line, row of the 5 embedded avatars, day/night toggle (respect prefers-color-scheme, remember choice with try/catch localStorage).
2. Team: 5 slim cards: picture, name, study programme, one-liner (all from the .md). Click/tap (a real <button>, keyboard accessible, aria-expanded) flips or expands the card into a "git log" view of that person: 3 to 4 fake commits built from their .md content (bio, fun fact, hot take), format "a1b2c3d  <message>". Keep commit messages kind and based on their real text.
3. Our take on AI and the future of software engineering (keep id="future-of-se"): 3 shared beliefs as an accordion or tabs (see content below) plus ONE "where we disagree" block: optimists vs sceptics with a toggle, styled like a stack trace.
4. Signature gimmick: the fake permission dialog (see below).
5. Footer: one line only. Drop the separate stats and predictions sections (fold one prediction into the future section as a joke if wanted).

SHARED VIEW CONTENT (edit lightly to fit the team's .md files, keep it short)
- First drafts are cheap, so judgement is the bottleneck.
- Prompting is not engineering: you still need to understand systems and failure modes.
- Humans stay accountable: "the AI did it" is not an incident report.
- Disagreement: will most code still be hand-written in ten years? Optimists: no, agents type, humans review. Sceptics: mostly yes, because deciding what to build is the hard part.

HUMOR (use these, keep the agent as a smug-but-lovable recurring character)
- Hero line: "Four humans, one agent, zero merge conflicts we will admit to." (adjust to 5 humans)
- Hero subline: "Built by an agent. Supervised by humans. Blamed on the agent."
- Theme toggle labels: light: "Night mode (the agent insists)"; dark: "Back to light, brave human".
- Agent quotes (rotate one per section, small italic text, prefix "Agent:"): "I did not break it. I refactored it." / "Looks good to me. I wrote it, so I would say that." / "Tests pass. I wrote those too." / "I would explain my diff, but you would have to read it."
- Section microcopy: Team: "Meet the humans. The agent asked to be listed as 'lead developer'. Request denied." Future: "We asked an AI to predict the future. It said 'it depends'." Disagreement footer: "We agree to disagree, then ask the agent to write a test for both opinions. Both pass. Suspicious."
- Fake stack trace for the disagreement block, e.g. "Exception: OpinionConflict at optimists.js:10 caused by sceptics.js:42".
- Card hover tooltip: "Click to run git log".
- Footer (one line): "No bugs were harmed in making this site. Several were promoted to features."
- Add playful alt text for avatars that still describes the person, e.g. "Photo of <name>".

SIGNATURE GIMMICK: FAKE PERMISSION DIALOG
A terminal-style card (dark in both themes) titled "agent@team18: permission request". Text: "The agent wants to write outside task1_opencode/ (external_directory)." Two buttons: [Allow] and [Think twice].
- Think twice: agent replies "Wise. Humans: 1, Agent: 0." and the dialog resets.
- Allow: agent types "Just kidding, I only wanted to read ../common/. Reading is fine." Then a line: "Lesson learned: reading outside is fine, think twice before writing outside."
Add a counter "Times a human thought twice: N" in memory only. Use a small typewriter effect that is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion. Buttons are real <button>s with visible focus.

EASTER EGG (hidden, not mentioned in the UI)
Konami code, or clicking the team name 5 times: the page briefly shows a banner "Debug mode: all 5 humans present, 1 agent supervised, 0 external dependencies." plus a gentle confetti of small emoji (reduced-motion safe, auto-dismiss after 4s).

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
- Embed every member picture into the file using embed_images.py (no external paths). Keep file size reasonable (resize images if the script supports it).
- Responsive: test at 375px and 1280px; no horizontal scroll; tap targets at least 44px.
- Day/night via CSS variables on :root with [data-theme]; AA contrast in both themes.
- Accessibility: semantic landmarks, one h1, skip link, keyboard operable cards/accordion/dialog, aria-labels, prefers-reduced-motion respected.
- Keep id="future-of-se" on the shared-view section.

FINISH
1. Run check_site.py and fix everything it reports.
2. Confirm: exactly 5 members from content/, no placeholder names left, no network requests, works in both themes.
3. Give me a 5-line summary of what changed and anything you were unsure about. Do not write outside task1_opencode/.

display.text: """Replaces image placeholders in an HTML file with embedded base64 data URIs. Placeholder format (anywhere in the HTML, typically in an ): {{image:anna.jpg}} Command line: python embed_images.py site/index.html --images content/images [--out site/index.html] From Python: from common.embed_images import embed_images html = embed_images(html, images_dir) Why? A base64-encoded photo is hundreds of thousands of characters. Letting the model write that would cost a huge number of output tokens and the model would get it wrong. """ from __future__ import annotations import argparse import base64 import re import sys from pathlib import Path MIME_TYPES = { ".jpg": "image/jpeg", ".jpeg": "image/jpeg", ".png": "image/png", ".gif": "image/gif", ".webp": "image/webp", ".svg": "image/svg+xml", } PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r"\{\{\s*image:\s*([^}\s]+)\s*\}\}") def image_to_data_uri(path: Path) -> str: mime = MIME_TYPES.get(path.suffix.lower()) if mime is None: raise ValueError(f"Unsupported image type: {path.name}") encoded = base64.b64encode(path.read_bytes()).decode("ascii") return f"data:{mime};base64,{encoded}" def embed_images(html: str, images_dir: Path) -> str: """Replace all {{image:}} placeholders. Raises FileNotFoundError for unknown files.""" images_dir = Path(images_dir).resolve() def replace(match: re.Match) -> str: path = (images_dir / match.group(1)).resolve() if images_dir not in path.parents: raise ValueError(f"Image path escapes the images directory: {match.group(1)}") if not path.is_file(): available = ", ".join(sorted(p.name for p in images_dir.iterdir())) or "none" raise FileNotFoundError(f"Image '{match.group(1)}' not found. Available: {available}") return image_to_data_uri(path) return PLACEHOLDER.sub(replace, html) def main() -> None: parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter) parser.add_argument("html_file", type=Path) parser.add_argument("--images", type=Path, required=True, help="directory containing the images") parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, help="output file (default: overwrite the input file)") args = parser.parse_args() html = args.html_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8") count = len(PLACEHOLDER.findall(html)) try: result = embed_images(html, args.images) except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as exc: print(f"Error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr) sys.exit(1) out = args.out or args.html_file out.write_text(result, encoding="utf-8") print(f"Embedded {count} image placeholder(s) → {out} ({out.stat().st_size / 1024:.0f} KB)") if __name__ == "__main__": main()

# Task 2 – Own Coding Agent

## Overview

This project implements a Python agent that generates a single-file team website from member profiles and the supplied style guide. It uses a custom JSON action loop and RAG, without an agent framework or native tool calling.

## Requirements

- Python 3.11 or newer
- Dependencies from the lab's `requirements.txt`
- Pillow (`python -m pip install Pillow`)
- UPB AI Gateway access (university network or VPN)
- Gateway credentials in `lab_1/group-18/.env`

Do not commit the `.env` file.

## Run

Run these commands from the repository root:

1. Test style-guide retrieval:

   ```bash
   python lab_1/group-18/task2_own_agent/rag.py
   ```

2. Generate the website:

   ```bash
   python lab_1/group-18/task2_own_agent/agent.py
   ```

   If the 15-step limit is reached, enter feedback to continue or `stop` to end the run.

3. Validate the generated website:

   ```bash
   python lab_1/group-18/common/site_checker.py lab_1/group-18/task2_own_agent/site/index.html --full --content lab_1/group-18/task1_opencode/content
   ```

4. Open `lab_1/group-18/task2_own_agent/site/index.html` in a browser.

Agent logs are saved in `lab_1/group-18/task2_own_agent/logs/`.

## Implementation

**`rag.py`** loads 55 Markdown style-guide documents, splits them into chunks of up to 160 words with a 30-word overlap, and generates embeddings using `kiconnect.qwen3-embedding-8b`. It ranks chunks by cosine similarity and returns relevant text with source filenames and scores. The default retrieval count is three, the observation budget is 950 tokens, and document embeddings are cached locally.

**`agent.py`** uses `openai.gpt-6-luna` and supports four JSON actions:

- `read_profiles` — load member profiles and match their photos.
- `search_style_guide` — retrieve relevant style-guide rules.
- `write_site` — generate the HTML, embed images, and run the checker.
- `finish` — end the run only after all checks pass.

The program returns action results and checker failures to the model for the next decision. It handles invalid JSON, limits repeated style-guide searches, and requests human input at the 15-step limit. Older HTML responses are shortened in the active conversation to limit context growth.

Images are resized and compressed with Pillow before being embedded as Base64 data URIs. Original image files are not modified.

## Results

The latest run used all five member profiles and images. The website checker results across revisions were:

`19/25 → 19/25 → 20/25 → 20/25 → 23/25 → 24/25 → 25/25`

The final HTML was approximately 139 KB and passed all 25 checks. The agent finished after 26 model calls, including one human continuation at the step limit. The run also recovered from an invalid JSON response on its first step.

Run log: `logs/agent_run_20261113_133231.jsonl`

## Design Decisions and Limitations

- JSON actions keep execution under Python's control without an agent framework.
- RAG retrieves relevant rules rather than placing all 55 documents in the prompt. Retrieved results can include deprecated rules, so the model must distinguish active versions.
- Checker feedback is used to revise the generated site, but multiple revisions may be needed.
- Embedding caching avoids repeating document embedding calls.
- Image compression keeps the self-contained HTML below the file-size limit.
- The agent requires UPB AI Gateway access and does not detect every form of repeated action.
- Conversation history still grows over long runs despite shortening older HTML responses.
- Human continuation is available at the step limit; the current code does not request new feedback after a successful `finish`.

1462:         </article>

1464:         <article class="belief">

1467:         </article>

1469:         <article class="belief">

1482:           </div>
1483:           <div>
1484:             <h4>The sceptics</h4>

1486:           </div>

      background:
        radial-gradient(60rem 36rem at 82% -12%, rgba(228, 0, 124, 0.34), transparent 62%),
        radial-gradient(48rem 34rem at 8% 118%, rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.34), transparent 60%),
        linear-gradient(140deg, #0B061C 0%, #170A34 46%, #2A0A3E 100%);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .site-header::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: -20%;
      right: -20%;
      bottom: -3rem;
      z-index: 0;
      height: 68%;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.09) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.09) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 3.5rem 3.5rem;
      transform: perspective(40rem) rotateX(62deg);
      transform-origin: bottom center;
      -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, #000 0%, transparent 80%);
      mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, #000 0%, transparent 80%);
      opacity: 0.65;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .site-header::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(24rem 24rem at var(--spot-x, 70%) var(--spot-y, 22%), rgba(228, 0, 124, 0.25), transparent 68%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-bg {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .orb {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: var(--radius-photo);
      filter: blur(3.5rem);
      opacity: 0.5;
      animation: orb-float 16s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .orb-one {
      top: -7rem;
      right: 6%;
      width: 24rem;
      height: 24rem;
      background: rgba(228, 0, 124, 0.42);
    }

    .orb-two {
      bottom: -8rem;
      left: 2%;
      width: 20rem;
      height: 20rem;
      background: rgba(155, 92, 255, 0.38);
      animation-delay: -7s;
    }

    .header-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 1.25rem 2rem 4rem;
    }

    .topbar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .brand {
      color: rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.7);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: color 200ms ease;
    }

    .brand:hover {
      color: var(--accent-bright);
    }

    .nav ul {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1.25rem;
      list-style: none;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    .nav a {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 0.5rem 0;
      color: rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.76);
      font-weight: 650;
      text-decoration: none;
      border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
      transition: color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease;
    }

    .nav a:hover {
      color: var(--accent-bright);
      border-bottom-color: var(--accent-bright);
    }

    #theme-toggle {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 2.75rem;
      height: 2.75rem;
      min-width: 2.75rem;
      padding: 0;
      color: var(--hero-ink);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
      border: 1px solid rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.22);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease;
    }

    #theme-toggle:hover {
      background: rgba(228, 0, 124, 0.26);
      border-color: var(--accent-bright);
      transform: rotate(-8deg) scale(1.04);
    }

    #theme-toggle svg {
      width: 1.25rem;
      height: 1.25rem;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .icon-sun,
    [data-theme="dark"] .icon-moon {
      display: none;
    }

    [data-theme="light"] .icon-moon,
    [data-theme="dark"] .icon-sun {
      display: block;
    }

    .hero-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.08fr) minmax(0, 0.92fr);
      gap: 3.25rem;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 4rem;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.55rem;
      margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
      color: rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.82);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      border: 1px solid rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.16);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
    }

    .pulse-dot {
      width: 0.5rem;
      height: 0.5rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-photo);
      background: #7EE787;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.22rem rgba(126, 231, 135, 0.16);
      animation: pulse-dot 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .hero-copy h1 {
      margin: 0.4rem 0 1.15rem;
      font-size: clamp(2.35rem, 6.2vw, 4.9rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.045em;
    }

    .title-lead {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 0.45em;
      color: var(--accent-bright);
      font-size: 0.3em;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.34em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .title-gradient {
      display: block;
      color: #FFD9EF;
      background: linear-gradient(100deg, #FFD1EA 0%, #FF6DBF 34%, #E4007C 62%, #C77DFF 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 1.4rem rgba(228, 0, 124, 0.36));
    }

    .tagline {
      max-width: 36rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
      color: rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.8);
      font-size: clamp(1.02rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
    }

    .hero-note {
      max-width: 34rem;
      margin-bottom: 0;
      color: rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.62);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin-top: 1.75rem;
    }

    .button {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.45rem;
      min-height: 2.75rem;
      padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem;
      border: 2px solid var(--accent);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      font: inherit;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease;
    }

    .button:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .button-primary {
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #FFFFFF;
      box-shadow: 0 0.75rem 2rem rgba(228, 0, 124, 0.3);
    }

    .button-primary:hover {
      background: #B0005F;
      box-shadow: 0 1rem 2.5rem rgba(228, 0, 124, 0.42);
    }

    .button-secondary {
      background: transparent;
      border-color: var(--button-border);
      color: var(--text);
    }

    .button-secondary:hover {
      background: var(--accent-soft);
      border-color: var(--accent);
    }

    .site-header .button-secondary {
      color: var(--hero-ink);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      border-color: rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.28);
    }

    .site-header .button-secondary:hover {
      background: rgba(228, 0, 124, 0.18);
      border-color: var(--accent-bright);
    }

    .hero-meta {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1.35rem;
      margin: 2rem 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
      color: rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.58);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
    }

    .hero-meta li {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      gap: 0.4rem;
    }

    .hero-meta strong {
      color: var(--hero-ink);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .hero-visual {
      position: relative;
      min-width: 0;
      padding: 1.5rem 1rem;
    }

    .float-chip {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.7rem;
      color: var(--hero-ink);
      background: rgba(10, 6, 28, 0.72);
      border: 1px solid rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.16);
      border-radius: 0.6rem;
      box-shadow: 0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
      font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      animation: chip-float 7s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .chip-a {
      top: -1.25rem;
      left: -1.25rem;
      color: var(--accent-bright);
      --rot: -5deg;
      animation-delay: -0.5s;
    }

    .chip-b {
      top: 7%;
      right: -1.4rem;
      color: #7AC7FF;
      --rot: 4deg;
      animation-delay: -2.4s;
    }

    .chip-c {
      bottom: 17%;
      left: -2.6rem;
      color: #7EE787;
      --rot: -3deg;
      animation-delay: -4.1s;
    }

    .chip-d {
      right: 7%;
      bottom: -1.2rem;
      color: #FFD166;
      --rot: 3deg;
      animation-delay: -1.2s;
    }

    .chip-e {
      top: 46%;
      right: -2.4rem;
      color: #C77DFF;
      --rot: 5deg;
      animation-delay: -3.2s;
    }

    .terminal {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      padding: 0;
      color: #F4F1DE;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(20, 20, 43, 0.98), rgba(9, 7, 24, 0.98));
      border: 1px solid rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.14);
      border-radius: 1.1rem;
      box-shadow:
        0 2rem 5rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),
        0 0 0 1px rgba(228, 0, 124, 0.14),
        0 0 4rem rgba(228, 0, 124, 0.18);
      font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    }

    .terminal::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0%, rgba(122, 199, 255, 0.05) 48%, transparent 52%);
      transform: translateY(-100%);
      animation: scan 8s linear infinite;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .terminal-bar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .terminal-dots {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.4rem;
    }

    .dot {
      width: 0.68rem;
      height: 0.68rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-photo);
    }

    .dot-red { background: #FF5F57; }
    .dot-yellow { background: #FEBC2E; }
    .dot-green { background: #28C840; }

    .terminal-title {
      flex: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: rgba(244, 241, 222, 0.58);
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      white-space: nowrap;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .terminal-live {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.35rem;
      color: #7EE787;
      font-size: 0.64rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .live-dot {
      width: 0.42rem;
      height: 0.42rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-photo);
      background: #7EE787;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgba(126, 231, 135, 0.16);
      animation: pulse-dot 2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    .terminal-body {
      padding: 1rem 1.15rem 1rem;
    }

    .terminal pre {
      margin: 0;
      white-space: pre-wrap;
      font: inherit;
    }

    .t-line {
      display: block;
      animation: line-in 500ms both;
    }

    .t-line:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 120ms; }
    .t-line:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 260ms; }
    .t-line:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 400ms; }
    .t-line:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 540ms; }
    .t-line:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 680ms; }
    .t-line:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 820ms; }
    .t-line:nth-child(7) { animation-delay: 960ms; }

    .terminal .prompt { color: #7AC7FF; }
    .terminal .ok { color: #7EE787; }
    .terminal .warn { color: #FFD166; }
    .terminal .cursor { color: var(--accent-bright); animation: blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite; }

    .terminal-progress {
      height: 0.28rem;
      margin-top: 0.9rem;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: rgba(247, 242, 255, 0.08);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
    }

    .terminal-progress span {
      display: block;
      width: 86%;
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--violet));
      border-radius: inherit;
      animation: progress-fill 2.4s ease-out both;
    }

    .terminal-status {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-top: 0.55rem;
      color: rgba(244, 241, 222, 0.5);
      font-size: 0.64rem;
    }

    .terminal-status strong {
      color: #7EE787;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    @keyframes orb-float {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) scale(1); }
      50% { transform: translate3d(0, -1.5rem, 0) scale(1.08); }
    }

    @keyframes chip-float {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(var(--rot, 0deg)); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-0.7rem) rotate(var(--rot, 0deg)); }
    }

    @keyframes pulse-dot {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.55; transform: scale(0.82); }
    }

    @keyframes blink {
      0%, 49% { opacity: 1; }
      50%, 100% { opacity: 0; }
    }

    @keyframes line-in {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0.35rem); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    }

    @keyframes progress-fill {
      from { width: 4%; }
      to { width: 86%; }
    }

    @keyframes scan {
      from { transform: translateY(-100%); }
      to { transform: translateY(100%); }
    }

    .tagline-strip {
      overflow: hidden;
      color: var(--bg);
      background: var(--text);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    }

    .tagline-viewport {
      display: flex;
      width: max-content;
      animation: ticker 34s linear infinite;
    }

    .tagline-strip:hover .tagline-viewport {
      animation-play-state: paused;
    }

    .tagline-track {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      padding: 0.7rem 1.5rem 0.7rem 0;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .tagline-track span {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }

    .tagline-dot {
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] .tagline-dot {
      color: var(--accent-bright);
    }

    @keyframes ticker {
      from { transform: translateX(0); }
      to { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    main {
      max-width: var(--max-width);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 3.5rem 2rem 4rem;
    }

    .section {
      margin-top: 4.5rem;
      scroll-margin-top: 1.5rem;
    }

    .section:first-child {
      margin-top: 0;
    }

    .kicker {
      margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .section-head {
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    .section-tagline {
      max-width: 65ch;
      margin: -0.1rem 0 1.4rem;
      padding-left: 1rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .js .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(1.5rem);
      transition: opacity 650ms ease, transform 650ms ease;
    }

    .js .reveal.is-visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: none;
    }

    .section-intro {
      max-width: 65ch;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }

    .demo-note {
      max-width: 65ch;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
      background: var(--accent-soft);
      border: 2px dashed var(--accent);
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
    }

    .demo-note strong {
      color: var(--text);
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent);
    }

    .member-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(16rem, 1fr));
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    .member-card {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
      padding: 1.5rem;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      transition: transform 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, background-color 250ms ease;
    }

    .member-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      border-color: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lift);
    }

    .member-card img {
      width: 8rem;
      height: 8rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      object-fit: cover;
      border: 4px solid var(--accent-soft);
      border-radius: var(--radius-photo);
      background: var(--accent-soft);
      transition: transform 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease;
    }

    .member-card:hover img {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      transform: scale(1.05) rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .member-card h3 {
      margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
    }

    .study {
      margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .member-tagline {
      margin: 0 0 0.7rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-style: italic;
    }

    .bio {
      margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    }

    .fun-fact {
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .hot-take {
      margin: auto 0 0;
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      background: var(--accent);
      color: #FFFFFF;
      border-radius: 0.5rem;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 650;
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .stats {
      padding: 2rem;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
      border-radius: 1.5rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    }

    .stat-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(9rem, 1fr));
      gap: 1.5rem;
      margin-top: 1.5rem;
    }

    .stat {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.25rem;
    }

    .stat-number {
      color: var(--accent);
      font-size: 2.5rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .stat-label {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .belief-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(16rem, 1fr));
      gap: 1.5rem;
      margin: 1.5rem 0 2rem;
    }

    .belief {
      padding: 1.5rem;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    }

    .belief h3 {
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .belief p {
      margin-bottom: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .disagreement {
      padding: 1.5rem;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
      border-left: 0.4rem solid var(--accent);
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    }

    .split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(15rem, 1fr));
      gap: 1.5rem;
      margin-top: 1rem;
    }

    .split h4 {
      display: inline-block;
      padding-bottom: 0.15rem;
      color: var(--text);
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent);
    }

    .split p {
      margin-bottom: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .disagreement-note {
      margin: 1.5rem 0 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .predictions {
      margin-top: 2.5rem;
    }

    .predictions ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .predictions li {
      padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
      border-radius: 0.75rem;
    }

    .predictions strong {
      margin-right: 0.5rem;
      color: var(--text);
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent);
    }

    footer {
      padding: 2rem 1rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--card-border);
    }

    footer p {
      margin: 0.25rem 0;
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] .member-card,
    [data-theme="dark"] .stats,
    [data-theme="dark"] .belief,
    [data-theme="dark"] .disagreement,
    [data-theme="dark"] .predictions li {
      box-shadow: none;
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .hero-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 2.5rem;
        padding-top: 2.75rem;

    <section id="team" class="section reveal" aria-labelledby="team-title">

      <p class="section-intro">

    <section id="future-of-se" class="section reveal" aria-labelledby="future-title">
      <div class="section-head">
        <p class="kicker">Shared view</p>
        <h2 id="future-title">The Future of Software Engineering</h2>
      </div>

      <p class="section-tagline">We asked an AI to predict the future. It said “it depends” and invoiced us for the tokens.</p>

      <p class="section-intro">
        Here is the part where we pretend to be futurists. We do not agree on everything, but we do agree on this: AI is changing how software gets made, and the engineer's job is moving from typing to judgement. In this lab we watched an agent build a website and then immediately asked it to explain itself. That is basically the job now.
      </p>

      <div class="belief-grid">
        <article class="belief">
          <h3>1. First drafts get cheap</h3>
          <p>That is the point — and the trap. A cheap draft is only useful if someone still reads it, questions it, and decides whether it belongs in the codebase.</p>
        </article>

        <article class="belief">
          <h3>2. The bottleneck moves to judgement</h3>
          <p>Specifying, reviewing, testing and documenting matter more, not less. The hard part is no longer typing the function; it is knowing which function deserves to exist.</p>
        </article>

        <article class="belief">
          <h3>3. Prompting is not engineering by itself</h3>
          <p>Understanding systems, data and failure modes is still the job. An agent can write the code, but it cannot own the consequences of a bad design decision.</p>
        </article>

        <article class="belief">
          <h3>4. Humans stay accountable</h3>
          <p>The best teams use agents for the boring parts and keep humans responsible for decisions that are hard to reverse. “The AI did it” is not an incident report.</p>
        </article>
      </div>

      <div class="disagreement">
        <h3>One thing we don't agree on</h3>
        <p><strong>Will most code still be written by hand in ten years?</strong></p>
        <div class="split">
          <div>
            <h4>The optimists</h4>
            <p>No. Agents will do most of the typing, and engineers will review, design and debug the weird stuff. We will look back at manual boilerplate the way we look at assembly language.</p>
          </div>
          <div>
            <h4>The sceptics</h4>
            <p>Mostly yes. The hard part of software is not typing; it is deciding what to build and why. Agents will write more code, but humans will still own the thinking — and the 3 a.m. incident call.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p class="disagreement-note">We agree to disagree, then ask the agent to write a test for both opinions. It passes. Suspicious.</p>
